pr_title: Normalize Nil PublicKeyToken to an empty array
pr_body:
This fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/66785   
(I verified manually, but I also had to re-baseline couple existing tests)

Also fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/69153

Is the current change fully addressing the problem from #69153 ?

> Is the current change fully addressing the problem from https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/69153 ?

I think so. The repro assembly has public key but does not have any flags, so we ended up using the full key value as a token. 
Thus we would report 160 byte array for the token and null for the key.
 
Forcing the `PublicKey` flag to be set unconditionally in definitions, once we see that there is a key, like in the native implementation, fixes the problem. 
After the change the repro assembly reports 8 byte token and 160 byte key, as in 6.0

issue_context.title: `AssemblyName.FullName` doesn't show `PublicKeyToken` portion when the `AssemblyName` instance is returned from `AssemblyName.GetAssemblyName`
comments: Likely introduced by the switch to managed implementation.

This is a matter of visualizing missing PublicKeyToken - whether we write out `PublicKeyToken=null` or not if the key is missing.

It looks like 6.0 prints that and we should too, but I wonder if that is always the case or there are other hints to consider on whether to print this or not.
Interestingly `PublicKeyToken` that is `null` is not visualized at all, but `PublicKeyToken` that is empty (i.e. Length == 0) is visualized as `PublicKeyToken=null`

review_comments:
It was not trivial to track this behavior to the native counterpart -

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/dd3cd5da4bc54f27e06c6dd080f2536ddbac6fd2/src/coreclr/vm/baseassemblyspec.inl#L328

In the native code we look at the length of the PKT (`m_cbPublicKeyOrToken`), and if it is `0`, then we set the `m_pbPublicKeyOrToken` to `1`. 
Later we look at `m_pbPublicKeyOrToken` and seeing it is not `0` we would create an array of length `0`.

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/eb9dd67ce9fc64c468cf5c795fda7057310c22fc/src/coreclr/vm/assemblyspec.cpp#L458
The second part was recently deleted when parsing was switched completely to managed. This is a link to an old version.
